title: tc-select
description: A single-choice dropdown: a secondary-button trigger that opens a listbox of options.

value.description: The chosen option's value – unset or unknown shows the placeholder

label.description: The control's accessible name; shown above the trigger with `label-visible`

labelVisible.description: Show `label` above the trigger instead of only to screen readers

placeholder.description: What the trigger says while no option is chosen

align.description: Which edge of the trigger the list lines up with

disabled.description: Turns the control off; the hidden form input is disabled too

name.description: Submits the chosen value with a native form, through a hidden input

value.description: What `value` holds when this option is chosen

label.description: The option's text, in the list and on the trigger

description.description: One short line under the label, in the list only

disabled.description: Shown but can't be picked; the keys skip it
